name: MBM Contracting
text: MENU Trusted Partner in Building Success Find The Right Solution For Your Needs General Contracting As the GC, MBM is responsible for working with trusted subcontractors and coordinating your construction project from beginning to end while ensuring the job is completed safely, on-time, within budget and according to specifications. Construction Management The CM delivery method allows us to collaborate with the owner and the design team from the earliest preconstruction stages of a project to expedite the delivery process. Design-Build The design-build delivery method allows for a fast-track construction process by eliminating lost time in the design-bid-build process and by identifying and ordering long lead items prior to the start of construction. Pre-Construction MBM offers pre-construction services including preliminary budgeting, constructability review, schedule development, value engineering, mock-ups, permitting, bid package preparation and more. Special Projects Our Special Projects division provides competitive and customized solutions on lower contract value projects that often times have tight timeframes. Self-Perform MBM employs highly skilled foremen and tradesmen, who self-perform key elements of our work which allows greater control of schedule and budget. name: Rochon Corporation
text: About Rochon Rochon Corporation is a commercial construction company focusing on General Contracting and Design Build Construction. Our industry leading projects include Educational, Office, Industrial, Multi-family, Religious and Retail building markets since 1985. Our organization is structured by three senior level principles with integrated expertise and leadership. They each have a major stake in the business, client, and outcome of the project. Support staff includes Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Superintendents and Office Team Members. Our total staff consists of 30-40 full time employees. We pride ourselves in over 85 years of senior level project management experience. Our history of success is achieved by establishing defined time schedules, accurate budgeting and complete dedication to the end result. We value client relationships and believe honest and straightforward communication is essential. Additionally, precise cost estimating is critical for setting the path and direction of the entire project. We use a process that that secures reliable budget estimates and only work with subcontractors we have confidence in. Our annual sales are approximately $90-$100 million. The majority of contracts are with repeat clients who work with us on a negotiated basis; in which they request our participation from inception through occupancy. Occasionally we will also be included on an invited bidders list or bid on public projects. The Rochon Advantage Rochon Corporation will help minimize your concerns and ensure success!
